theme_cn: 模板写作 + KET/PET题型 + 语法复习 + 听力 + 键盘拼写
listening_name: 听力：听对话 + 选图 + 听写

ket_pet.question: KET: I'd like ___ ticket to Beijing, please.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: ticket 是可数名词单数，泛指「一张」用 a。

ket_pet.question: KET: ___ is the ticket? — Twenty yuan.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 问价格用 How much；How many 问可数数量。

ket_pet.question: PET: This is the station ___ we met last year.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 先行词是地点 station，从句 we met 不缺宾语，缺地点状语，用 where。

ket_pet.question: PET: The train was so crowded that we ___ stand all the way.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: so...that 从句描述过去的情况，用 had to（不得不）表示过去的必须。

ket_pet.question: PET: She asked me ___ I had finished the project.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 宾语从句原本是一般疑问句，转述时用 whether/if 引导。

grammar.question: 改错：Both of us is students. 哪个改法是对的？
grammar.explanation_cn: both of us / both of them… 作主语是复数概念，动词用 are。

grammar.question: 改错：There aren't some apples in the box. 哪个改法是对的？
grammar.explanation_cn: 否定句里 some 要改成 any；apples 是复数，aren't 本身没错。

grammar.question: 改错：Could you give me any food? 哪个改法是对的？
grammar.explanation_cn: Could you…? 是委婉请求，希望对方答应，要用 some。

grammar.question: 改错：Both of them likes playing basketball. 哪个改法是对的？
grammar.explanation_cn: both of them 是复数，动词不加 s：like。

grammar.question: 改错：All of us is keen on jazz. 哪个改法是对的？
grammar.explanation_cn: all of us（我们所有人）是复数 → are。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. Why do people eat zongzi?
listening.audio_text: Girl: Dad, why do we eat zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival? Dad: Because we want to remember the poet Qu Yuan. Girl: And what are those long boats for? Dad: They are for the dragon boat races.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 Because we want to remember the poet Qu Yuan（为了纪念诗人屈原）。后半段说的是龙舟，不是粽子的用意。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. When did Grandma learn to make zongzi?
listening.audio_text: Boy: Can you make zongzi, Grandma? Grandma: Yes, I learned it from my mother when I was ten. Boy: It looks difficult. Grandma: It is easy once you try.
listening.explanation_cn: 奶奶说 I learned it from my mother when I was ten（十岁时跟妈妈学的）。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: We watched the dragon boat race on the river yesterday.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说的是 dragon boat race（龙舟比赛），船在河上，所以选 🛶。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: Every year we cook more zongzi than we need and share them with our ___.
listening.audio_text: Every year we cook more zongzi than we need and share them with our friends.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到的是 share them with our friends（和朋友们分享），friends 是复数。

spell.question: 粽子：d________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: dumpling 中间是 mpl，读 /ˈdʌmplɪŋ/；rice dumpling 就是粽子。

spell.question: 节日：f_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: festival 重音在第一个音节，读 /ˈfestɪvl/。

spell.question: 比赛：r___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: race 读 /reɪs/，dragon boat race 就是龙舟比赛。

spell.question: 分享：s____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: share sth. with sb. 和某人分享某物，读 /ʃeə/。

mc.question: ___ sweets would you like? — A lot. I love them!
mc.explanation_cn: sweets 糖果，可数复数 → How many；回答 A lot。

mc.question: ___ bananas do you eat in a week? — Only a few. One or two, maybe.
mc.explanation_cn: bananas 可数复数 → How many；回答用 a few（修饰可数）。

mc.question: ___ pasta would you like? — Just a little. I'm not very hungry.
mc.explanation_cn: pasta 意面，不可数 → How much；a little 修饰不可数名词。

mc.question: ___ ice cream would you like? — A little, please. It's my favourite!
mc.explanation_cn: ice cream 这里按不可数用 → How much；A little 一点点。

mc.question: ___ bread have we got? — Only a little. We need to buy some.
mc.explanation_cn: bread 面包，不可数 → How much。

mc.question: ___ oranges are you going to buy? — None. I haven't got any money in my bag.
mc.explanation_cn: oranges 可数复数 → How many；None 一个也没有。

mc2_name: a few / a little · some / any

mc2.question: ___ sugar would you like in your milk?
mc2.explanation_cn: sugar 糖，不可数 → How much。

mc2.question: Don't use ___ salt. It's not good for you.
mc2.explanation_cn: salt 盐不可数 → too much；too many 只修饰可数复数。

mc2.question: There are still ___ carrots in the fridge. We can make soup with them.
mc2.explanation_cn: carrots 可数复数 → a few；a little 只修饰不可数。

mc2.question: ___ fruit should we eat every day?
mc2.explanation_cn: fruit 泛指水果时不可数 → How much。

mc2.question: Is there ___ butter left for the cake?
mc2.explanation_cn: butter 黄油不可数，不能用 a；一般疑问句用 any。

mc2.question: Would you like ___ more bread?
mc2.explanation_cn: Would you like…? 是邀请、提供东西，语气希望对方答应 → some。
